trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression visible at the center of the fluke, forming a sharp angular vertex where the two lobes meet.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing boundary, characterized by jagged peaks and protrusions caused by dense calcified encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed along the trailing edges of the visible lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly downward-sloping tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity beige and white pixels located on the lateral margins and distal tips, corresponding to extensive barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle encrustations concentrated along the entire visible trailing edge and fluke tips.
